changes.comment: Internal: RPC inputs, index rows, dump files, and package manifests are parsed with zod/mini schemas. Malformed input now gets an error: reconstruct without eventId throws instead of returning unavailable, and list-sessions rejects a since above 2^53. A baked report record with neither output nor error already failed the build with a TypeError; only the message is new: the record is not an output or an error.
